title: fix(lint)!: four publish-time checks for data-model metadata that saves and does not work
body:
Part of #35143

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: follow-up #37529

## 维护者速读

- 搭应用的人在发布对象和本地校验时,会被拦下两类“保存成功却不工作”的字段(汇总字段的子对象没有指回父对象、给不能关联记录的字段填了关联目标),另有两类只提醒不拦截。
- 属于“发布期作者规则第二批”中的数据模型一族,替搭应用的人在保存时就发现汇总永远是 0、记录选择器把编号写进文本字段这类问题。
- 已经存好的对象不会被改写也不会在启动时被拒,只是下次发布被拦并给出改法;误拦时撤回这次合并即可恢复。
- 无

## What changes

The Data model family of the card's second batch of publish-time checks, five lines, each verified on `origin/main` first.

| Line | Verdict on main | This PR |
|---|---|---|
| D1 lookup named like a count or total | holds, no rule | new warning `field/count-named-lookup` |
| D2 formula reading an unconfigured summary | **already covered** — `field/summary-without-operations` refuses the summary itself | no rule; a coverage pin at the runtime gate |
| D3 summary whose child has no reference back | holds, no rule | new error `rollup/child-without-parent-reference`, added to the existing `lintSummaryRollups` |
| D4 `reference` on a type that reads none | holds, no rule | new error `field/reference-on-non-reference-type` |
| D5 approval detail editable while pending | holds, no rule | new warning `approval-detail-editable-while-pending`, added to the existing `validateApprovalApprovers` |

- **D3** follows the engine's summary index (`buildSummaryIndex`). It reads `summaryOperations.relationshipField` when that is set. Otherwise it looks for the first `master_detail` / `lookup` on the child that references the parent. When the index finds no foreign key, the summary is skipped with nothing logged, so the field reads 0 or empty while every child write reports success.
  - The check counts the child's fields as served, including fields added by an object extension. It also counts the injected columns (`owner_id`, `created_by` and `updated_by` back to `sys_user`, plus the tenancy lookups).
  - A child the stack does not hold is not judged.
  - The finding is reported beside the existing aggregand arms, not instead of them.
- **D4** fires when a non-blank `reference` sits on any type outside `REFERENCE_VALUE_TYPES` plus `summary`. `summary` is exempt because the hosted blueprint reads `summary` + `reference`.
  - It runs on objects and on object extensions.
  - The record page's inline editor sends any field with a `reference` to the record picker, except the textual fallback types. For text, number and date fields the message therefore names the record-id write; a select and the other types the inline editor routes first are told only that the key links nothing.
- **D1** and **D4** sit in one new gating entry, `lintFieldReferenceShapes`, which runs on both the `object` and the `object_extension` door. D1 is a warning, so it comes back as a 2xx advisory.
- **D5**: an approval node with `lockRecord` not set to `false` makes the rule look at the flow's start object. If that object has a non-multiple `lookup` child drawn as a body table (`relatedList: 'primary'`, read through `isBodyTableRelationship`), the rule warns once per flow. The approval lock covers `master_detail` children only.
- **Export surface:** no new exports and no new catalogs. The new rule ids are module-local, which matches the Flows precedent's r2 PASS. The authoring-rule count in four docs pages moves from 80 to 81.
- **Upgrade guide:** new ADR-0087 semantic entry `publish-refuses-data-model-fields-that-save-and-do-not-work` in `@objectstack/spec`. It is a notice only, because each fix is a choice only the author can make.

## Tests

- `data-model-rules.field-reference-shapes.test.ts` (new) covers D4 and D1:
  - both fire, and stay silent on legal shapes;
  - the object-extension location is reported;
  - the runtime gate refuses D4 on `object` and on `object_extension`, and returns D1 as an advisory.
- `data-model-rules.summary-rollup.test.ts` covers D3:
  - fires on a child with no foreign key, and on a `relationshipField` that names no field of the child;
  - silent with `master_detail`, with `lookup`, with a `relationshipField` that names a real child field, when the child is absent, for `sys_user` via the injected column, and for a foreign key added by an extension on the CLI;
  - the runtime gate refuses, and passes once fixed.
- `validate-functional-completeness.test.ts` covers D2: a bare summary that a formula reads is refused at the gate as `field/summary-without-operations`.
- `validate-approval-approvers.test.ts` covers D5:
  - warns on a primary lookup child;
  - silent for a `master_detail` child, a non-body lookup and `lockRecord: false`;
  - rides the flow door as an advisory.
- Door roster pins: `lintFieldReferenceShapes` is added to the exact `rulesRun` lists in three runtime-gate test files.

## Acceptance notes

- **The Clause-② line differs from the dispatch order's literal spelling.** The order asks for `Clause-②: no` together with `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`. The changeset gate refuses `narrowed` without the `(narrowing)` arm. Two of the checks refuse a publish that used to be accepted, so the change narrows. This PR therefore carries `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` and a `!` title, the same as the Flows precedent.
- **D2 has no new rule.** On main, a summary with no `summaryOperations` is already refused as itself, so the formula that reads it cannot publish either. That is recorded and pinned.
- **D4 exempts `summary`,** because the hosted blueprint reads `summary` + `reference`. `formula` and `autonumber` still fire, but their message drops the record-picker clause because they have no editor.
- **D1 and D5 are warnings.** They refuse nothing and make `os validate --strict` exit 1, as any warning does. D1 rides the object door as a gating-rule warning, so it comes back as an advisory, not a refusal.
- **Reading outside this card (R8 in `lintDataModel`).** R8 counts `refOf(def)`, and the keys `optionsFrom` / `dataSource`, as select option sources. Neither key exists in the spec. This is a carrier note and is not filed.
- **Collision with #37422.** That PR also bumps the authoring-rule count in the same four docs pages, so they conflict textually. Whichever lands second takes the higher count. `authoring-rules.ts` merges cleanly.
- **Skills-docs** follow-up is owed, as declared above.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/data-model-rules.field-reference-shapes.test.ts src/data-model-rules.summary-rollup.test.ts`. Expect every case to pass.

Read first, by risk:
1. `packages/lint/src/data-model-rules.ts`, the D3 relation arm in `summaryRollupFindings`. It must agree with the engine's foreign-key choice, or it refuses roll-ups that compute.
2. `packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts`: the new entry's doors (`object`, `object_extension`) and the served-fields map passed to the roll-up check.
3. `packages/lint/src/validate-approval-approvers.ts`: the body-table reading for D5.

Readings at final head ad43f0b4: lint 237/237 files, 9682 tests (at 2740a172); app-shell narrowed set 221/221 files, 2429 tests (at 48d632c3) plus the retype pin file at ad43f0b4; dogfood battery 487 passed, 3 skipped files, 4129 passed, 68 skipped tests; CI 63 success, 11 skipped, 0 failed (after the body edit re-ran four jobs).

Follow-ups from the contract review nits: #37577.

Also in this PR: 77ac3ce2 gives the objectql duplicatePackage roll-up fixture's child a foreign key back to its parent (the new rollup/child-without-parent-reference refusal turned that stale fixture red); 48d632c3 and ad43f0b4 make the console field designer drop reference on a retype to a type that reads none and strip a stored one at its read door (contract review M1, under the seat's scope line 7190889569), with its own @object-ui/app-shell patch changeset.
